title: Praedos
extract:
Praedos is an Incarnon ceremonial tonfa. Once its Incarnon form is unlocked, Tenno can transform this weapon in battle by executing a Heavy Attack with a Melee Combo of 5x or higher, increasing the weapon's range and attack speed.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Gemini Cross and  Star Divide (Conclave only) stance.
As an Incarnon weapon, Praedos has 5 evolution tiers with different perks that allow players to customize their Praedos' stats.
Activate Incarnon form by executing a Heavy Attack with a Melee Combo of 5x or higher (3x with Swift Transmute).
When the transformation is ready, the combo counter will shimmer with Void energy.
Incarnon form lasts for 90 seconds and behaves as follows:
+3 Range
+40% Attack Speed.
The transformation persists through all states such as holstering, bleedout and disarm, but is removed upon death.

Acquisition
Praedos' main blueprint is purchased from Cavalero of The Holdfasts at Rank 4 - Seraph for  9,000 Standing. The blueprint can be traded.

Notes
When newly acquired from the Foundry, players must acquire 100 kills with the Praedos in order to gain access to its Incarnon transformation. Each challenge additionally grants 5,000 affinity to the weapon, affected by Affinity Boosters. The following Evolution tiers, their requirements for unlocking them, and their related perks, are shown below.

Overview
Incarnon Form is charged by building Melee Combo to 5x, then using a Heavy Attack. Once activated, the Incarnon form lasts for 90 seconds.
Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, bleedout, or being disarmed. However, Incarnon Form is removed upon death.

Evolutions

Tips
Combining  Corrupt Charge and Adept Reflexes grants a passive minimum 3x Melee Combo, allowing Swift Transmute to immediately transform Praedos at will.
 True Punishment affects Shockwave Synergy, effectively doubling the Combo Count gain from 4 to 8 per enemy hit by the Slam radius. It is also affected by other sources that grant additional combo count chance.
Using an Exalted Weapon will negate Evolution V challenge.
Incarnon Genesis weapons are counted for Evolution V challenge.
The increase to Parkour Velocity from Evolved Ascension is passive, and does not require the Praedos to be held to be active.

Trivia
Praedo means robber or plunderer in Latin.
While in Incarnon form, Praedos will exude a turquoise aura.
